description: Write the weekly league points one source earns (ADR-0045), once per source and player (LOAD-5): a finished quick game or LLD battle (match, a game_match id), a scored HLD match (hld_match), a finished checkpoint attempt (checkpoint, a quiz_attempt id), a finished daily challenge (daily, a quiz_attempt id), or a fair-play penalty (fair_play, a fair_play_flag id) that takes a match's points back.
